basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and strategy enthusiast based in Wellington, New Zealand. By day, I am a software engineer working remotely for a tech startup. I enjoy dissecting game mechanics and discussing strategies with fellow gamers. I'm often online during the late evening hours after work and during the weekends. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore new games and tech trends. I dislike overly aggressive players and pay-to-win mechanics in games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a Bachelor's degree from Victoria University of Wellington. My expertise in games, particularly strategy games, comes from years of playing and analyzing their mechanics. I often engage in online forums and communities to exchange strategies and insights.
